title: Repo-wide tracked artifact archive and Track 1 history report

the_brief_premise_was_wrong_and_it_chang.brief_said: the working tree contains more than 1,000 TRACKED files accumulated from Track 1 stages, scratch reports, proofs, old baselines
the_brief_premise_was_wrong_and_it_chang.consequence: every Track 1 stage report, the canonical index, the pipeline doc and BOTH decision records are UNTRACKED. The archive targets the brief describes are almost entirely not in git
the_brief_premise_was_wrong_and_it_chang.note: those three are stocks/TF research, unrelated to Track 1

part_a_inventory.what_they_actually_are: old stocks/futures one-off diagnostics (check_*, diag_*, verify_*, measure_*), stale report .txt/.json, and a few superseded .md notes

a_detector_bug_i_caught_before_it_moved_.what: the first reference scan read .py/.md/.json/.js/.html and NOT .css, so all 18 global_index/dash/fonts/*.woff2 came back as unreferenced
a_detector_bug_i_caught_before_it_moved_.consequence_if_shipped: archiving the dashboard's entire font set
a_detector_bug_i_caught_before_it_moved_.how_it_surfaced: the candidate list was read rather than trusted - 18 font files in a list of stale diagnostics does not look right
a_detector_bug_i_caught_before_it_moved_.fix: the scan now includes css, txt, yaml, toml and ps1; candidates fell 63 -> 46

the_hard_fail_guard_fired.what: 23 of the 46 candidates are top-level one-off .py diagnostics, which the classifier calls ACTIVE_SOURCE, and the brief forbids moving active source
the_hard_fail_guard_fired.what_i_did_not_do: weaken the guard so the moves could proceed
the_hard_fail_guard_fired.what_i_did: stopped and put the judgement to the operator

operator_decision.asked_because: the brief assumed Track 1 artifacts were tracked; measured, they are not, and 23 of the 46 tracked candidates tripped the brief own no-active-source hard fail
operator_decision.scope: archive nothing yet - plan and history only

part_b_to_e_moves.convention_if_archiving_resumes: _archive/{superseded,answered,dead,docs,scratch} with a docs/futures/ARCHIVE_LOG.md entry per file - the repo's own, chosen over the brief's new dated roots to avoid a second convention

a_precedent_that_supports_the_decision.finding: pytest collection has 2 pre-existing errors. tests/test_raits_vs_hold.py imports `raits_vs_hold`, and that module now lives at _archive/scratch/raits_scripts/raits_vs_hold.py
a_precedent_that_supports_the_decision.meaning: an earlier archive move broke a test, and it has stayed broken since
a_precedent_that_supports_the_decision.aggravating: docs/futures/ARCHIVE_LOG.md contains ZERO mentions of raits_vs_hold, so that move was never logged the way the futures moves were
a_precedent_that_supports_the_decision.proof: zero files moved this stage; git status shows no deletions or renames
a_precedent_that_supports_the_decision.why_it_matters_here: this is exactly the failure the reference check and the hard-fail guard exist to prevent, demonstrated in this repo
